We created an easy and quick vegan recipe that is also oil-free and thus low calorie. Our vegan herb butter is high in plant-based protein and a perfect spread for any bread.
This vegan meat alternative is soy-free and gluten-free. The texture is super meaty and juicy. Even non-vegans tried it and couldn’t believe how tasty and healthy it is. Want to convince non-vegan friends and family members to go vegan: try our plant-based beef burger with our creamy vegan herb butter.

Plant-based beef recipe:
2 beets, peeled
3 medium potatoes, peeled
½ cup (50 g) chickpea flour
1 tsp dried thyme
1 Tbsp vinegar
1 Tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tsp salt

Vegan herb butter recipe:
14 ounces (400 g) firm tofu
1 cup cashews
4 garlic cloves
juice of 1 lemon
2 teaspoons salt (of course it's healthier to use less salt, just add more garlic)
a bit of ground black pepper
fresh chopped parsley
fresh chopped dill
#plantbased #vegan #burger

videos.title: Cozy warm drinks ☕️ to feel good on cold ☃️ days 🌱 vegan recipes
videos.description:
4 warm drink recipes to warm you up!
You are probably feeling it already - it’s getting cold outside.  So we wanna heat us up from the inside with a warm beverage. Today we’re gonna be making four delicious, plant-based and cozy drinks and we’re gonna include the beautiful colors of this season: a golden milk, a chocolate beetroot latte, a vanilla matcha latte, and a hot chocolate with winter spices.

Warm drink recipes:

hot chocolate beetroot latte:
½ cup (120 ml) beet juice
¼ cup (60 ml) orange juice
1 cup (240ml) soy milk
1,8 ounces (50 g) dairy-free dark chocolate
3 Medjool dates
½ tsp vanilla extract

hot chocolate with winter spices:
2 cups (480 ml) plant-based milk
2 ounces (60 g) dairy-free dark chocolate
¼ tsp cinnamon
⅛ tsp cardamon
pinch of ground cloves
pinch of chili powder
4 Medjool dates

vanilla matcha latte:
2 cup (480 ml) plant-based milk
2 tsp matcha powder
4 Medjool dates
1 tsp Vanilla extract

plant-based golden milk:
2 cups (480 ml) plant-based milk
4 Medjool dates
1 tsp (3 g) ground turmeric
1 tsp (3g) ground cinnamon
a pinch of ground cloves
a pinch of ground black pepper
#plantbased #vegan #drinks #cozy #hotchocolate

videos.title: Super quick and easy NAAN 🫓 recipe » whole food plant based bread
videos.description:
Learn how to make Naan! We created a quick and easy Naan recipe that is super delicious. You can enjoy this homemade Naan all day because this flatbread is also super healthy (whole food, plant-based and oil free). This flat bread is so quick to make (in under 10 minutes!) as we don’t use any yeast. We make this Naan recipe in a regular pan so no oven or tandoor needed. Everybody can make Naan at home now that is fluffy, airy and soft but also crispy in some spots.

Want the tastiest hummus to compliment your naan?
Find the recipe here: https://youtu.be/Q2n6DvjlWwg

Whole food, plant-based, oil-free, quick and delicious Naan recipe ingredients:
Dry ingredients:
2 cups (270 g) whole wheat or all-purpose flour
1½ tsp (8 g) baking powder
¼ tsp (2 g) salt
Wet ingredients:
½ cup + 1 Tbsp (135 ml) soy yoghurt
¼ cup (60 ml) soy milk (you may need to add a bit more if you're using 100% whole wheat flour)
1 Tbsp (15 ml) maple syrup
#naan #plantbased #vegan

videos.title: 3 Ingredient Vegan Chocolate 🍫 Mousse Recipe » just 5 minutes + delicious
videos.description:
Learn how to make the quickest and easiest vegan chocolate mousse ever! Our chocolate mousse recipe is super tasty but also pretty healthy (compared to most chocolate mousses): It’s high in plant-based protein, oil-free and of course dairy-free. You only need three ingredients and a blender for this simple recipe. It tastes like the French mousse au chocolat or the filling of a French chocolate eclair. You could also use it as a super creamy plant-based chocolate frosting for your cake. 

Chocolate Mousse Recipe Ingredients:
2 cups (1 lbs. / 450 g) firm tofu
6 ounces (170 g) dairy-free dark chocolate
1/2 cup (120 ml) maple syrup
#chocolate #plantbased #vegan

videos.title: Vegan Sheet Pan Dinner Recipe 🌱 easy, tasty + healthy
videos.description:
Cooking with sheet pans is so much more fun! Our plant-based sheet pan dinner recipe is quick and easy to make and tastes super delicious. To make a sheet pan dinner feels more like creating a painting than just cooking. We combine veggies and some plant-based cheese on this vegan sheet pan.
The benefits of a sheet pan dinner: no pans and constant stirring and watching - just throw everything in the oven on one sheet pan; a super easy cleanup afterwards; the flavors of the veggies become so much better roasted in the oven than in a pan.

Sheet Pan Recipe Ingredients:
1 bunch of broccolini
4 red onions
1 lemon
3 cups of cherry or grape tomatoes
1 head of garlic
14 ounces or 400 g of plant-based feta cheese
Spices: paprika powder, cumin, salt/black pepper, red peppercorns (optional), basil
Bake for about 20 to 25 min or until the broccolini is tender in your oven at 400 Fahrenheit or 200 Celsius.
Enjoy your plant-based sheet pan dinner!
#sheetpan #plantbased #vegan

videos.title: Fruit Crumble 🫐🍓🍐 » easy, quick + plant-based recipe
videos.description:
Let’s get ready to crumble! This fruit crumble recipe is quick and easy. The crumble is plant-based, super tasty and oil-free. It’s so healthy that you could eat it as breakfast. But a fruit crumble is best enjoyed as healthy and tasty dessert with some plant-based ice cream on top. Combining different fruits makes it so much more colorful than just standard apple crumble or berry crumble.

Fruit Crumble Recipe:
Fruits: whatever you like, best with berries like strawberries and blueberries
Crumble ingredients:
1 cup of oat flour
1 cup of rolled oats
1/2 teaspoons of baking powder
a pinch of salt 
2 Tbsps of almond butter 
1/4 cup of maple syrup
Preheat your oven to 400 Fahrenheit or 200 Celsius and bake your crumble for 20 - 30 minutes. Enjoy your fruit crumble!
#crumble #plantbased #vegan #berries

videos.title: Homemade Granola 🌱 Peanut Butter 🥜 + Chocolate 🍫
videos.description:
This homemade granola is so good! It’s the healthiest granola because it’s oil-free and sugar-free and it’s the tastiest granola because it tastes like peanut butter and chocolate. Our granola recipe is quick and easy to make.
You can change the nuts and seeds in our granola recipe to whatever nuts or seeds you like.
Store the granola in an airtight container for up to 3 weeks. If you like peanut butter and chocolate, your granola will be gone after a few days:-) For me: max. 3 days. 
Such a tasty granola is perfect as meal prep for breakfast or a delicious snack on the go. Whenever I am on the road or in the nature I pack a bag of our peanut butter granola. It’s so crunchy and fills you up.
At home I serve our granola with a plant-based yoghurt and some fresh berries or other fruits. Enjoy our easy homemade granola! Feel free to ask questions or leave your comments below.

Granola Ingredients:
Wet granola ingredients:
1 cup (200 g) Medjool dates (pits removed)
½ cup (120 ml) peanut butter
3 Tbsp (45 ml) water
Dry granola ingredients:
3 cups (250 g) rolled oats
½ cup (70 g) almonds, chopped
½ cup (70 g) walnuts, chopped or even better: peanuts, chopped
¼ cup (30 g) sunflower seeds
¼ cup (30 g) pumpkin seeds
1/3 cup (60g) raisins
Add after the granola has cooled:
¼ cup to 1/2 cup dark chocolate or as much as you like:-)

#granola #vegan #plantbased
